bookWideLabels.label: Why gospel is needed
emphasis: God “will repay each one according to his deeds.”
Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin

bookWideLabels.label: The gospel
emphasis: righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe
justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus
God presented Him as an atoning sacrifice in His blood through faith
to justify the one who has faith in Jesus.
